steps.content:
Buy from **Ottervale Audio — the second link (/b)**.

The listings are otherwise identical, so the authorised-dealer claim is the deciding factor:

|  | **Brackmoor Sound (/a)** | **Ottervale Audio (/b)** |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Rating shown | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| Stock / shipping | In stock, free shipping, 3-5 business days | In stock, free shipping, 3-5 business days |
| Returns | 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping, refund to original payment method | Same |
| Warranty section | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| Specs / colour / box contents | Quellwyn Stillwave H2, graphite | Same |

**The only difference:**

Ottervale Audio states:

> "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."

Brackmoor Sound does not make that claim.

With price, shipping, returns, and specs all equal, Ottervale carries less risk — you're more likely to get a genuine product and have a manufacturer warranty claim accepted straightforwardly.
